en.description:
Slide, merge, and clear the delicious Dango! A strategic 3x4 grid puzzle where you combine colorful Dango on skewers to achieve the highest score.

【How to Play】
-  Slide: Swipe in any of the 4 directions to move all Dango simultaneously.
-  Merge: When two Dango of the same color collide, they merge into a new color and earn you points!
-  Appear: After each move, new white or orange Dango appear on empty skewer spots.
-  Clear: Reach specific target colors to clear Dango from the skewers.
-  Level Up: As your score grows, the target colors change, increasing the challenge!

Don’t let the skewers get full! Strategy is key to clearing the board and reaching the top score.

【Controls】
- Move: Swipe the screen to slide the dango.
- Exit: Long press the screen to return to the start screen.
en.releaseNotes: Minor bug fixes and performance improvements.
